0022600097.text: Toronto has not played a 2026-27 game yet and is missing Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot), while Washington is 1-0 at home, sits 2nd in the Southeast and 4th in the East, and is without AJ Dybantsa (out, ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (out, knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 134-125 win in Washington on February 28, 2026. Toronto's own record for 2026-27 is still 0-0, so this is the Raptors' first time on the court this season.
